reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/help.rs defines the static help image and size. The module owns the 17587-byte help array, its default size scalar and a one-entry static constructor table; all are image storage.
owner_creation.invariant: All module owners have static image lifetime.
limitations: The 17587-byte literal and default size do not own loaded translations.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/help.rs lends default help bytes to lmsg. The exported array and size are borrowed/copied by lmsg; allocated translations replace help_data and size_help_data separately from these owners.
aliases_escapes.invariant: The default image and allocated translations stay distinct.
limitations: lmsg help_data may point elsewhere while helpdata stays image-owned.

callback_targets.analysis: src/help.rs registers the size initializer in init_array. The only function is c2rust_run_static_initializers; INIT_ARRAY retains its exact C-ABI target to initialize the default size.
callback_targets.invariant: Every module callback target is explicitly enumerated.
limitations: INIT_ARRAY review is limited to the size constructor target.

invalidation.analysis: src/help.rs does not replace the literal help array. The complete byte table was inspected as literals only; the maintained tree contains no array replacement or post-startup size assignment.
invalidation.invariant: Default help backing storage is never resized.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/help.rs derives help size during static initialization. Literal bytes exist before constructors; the size callback derives 17586 non-NUL bytes from the compiled array type.
mutation_commit.invariant: Help length is established before application reads.

release_pair.analysis: src/help.rs requires default help storage to remain unfreed. The module acquires no allocator block; default storage must not be freed, and lmsg uses owned_help to distinguish heap replacements.
release_pair.invariant: Static help bytes are excluded from heap cleanup.
limitations: Heap translations need their separate owned_help release policy.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/help.rs performs no fallible translation loading. There is no fallible I/O or allocation in this file; failed translation loading must retain a valid static fallback in its separate owner.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/help.rs initializes size before handler registration. The one constructor runs before application handlers and only writes the size; text aliases are read-only in maintained application code.
signals_handoff.invariant: No callback mutates default help text during paging.
limitations: The fixed help image is reviewed here; lmsg allocated replacements, help_data aliases and retained-input owners remain separate pending reviews.

src/lmsg.rs.relationship: init_lmsg at src/lmsg.rs:2587-2592 frees owned_help before restoring borrowed helpdata and size_helpdata. The selected message owner is distinct from the image array in help.rs.
